text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — we're doing a roll-forward of the new price sheet into the sandbox cohort today at 16:00 PT for the A/B experiment. Need billing + vendor signoff before we flip any traffic.
Rohan: ETA on the vendor confirmation? also does this change affect invoice formatting?
Maya: vendor emailed back earlier, they approved the rate table but asked for a shadow-run first. invoice layout unchanged; only unit prices change.
Elena: For grandfathering — what's the eligibility window? do we keep legacy credits?
Maya: Grandfathering window = accounts created before 2025-01-01. Legacy promo credits preserved for 90 days post-roll. I pasted the mapping below.
Maya: ```
# pricing_map snippet
sku: "gen-short"
variant_a_price: 0.008
variant_b_price: 0.010
legacy_customer: true => preserve_credit_days=90
```
Sophia: For reconciliation, we'll run a shadow invoice job against the sandbox cohort overnight and diff line-items. I can own the diff report.
Jordan: Vendor wants a short memo that the experiment is limited to sandbox & won't change SLA/settlement terms. I'll draft and loop them in.
BillingBot: [system] Scheduled job: shadow-invoice-run queued for 2026-03-03T02:00:00Z (job id: job_78321).
Rohan: Great — what's the canary size? we should cap token spend to avoid surprise charges.
Maya: Canary -> 50 customers, max tokens per-customer = 500k/day. Auto-rollback if spend delta > 25% vs baseline or error_rate > 1%.
Sophia: I'll add the spend cap checks to the diff script and post results to this thread.
Elena: Approvals: FinanceOps, Vendor legal, Product PM signoff needed. where do we collect signatures?
FinanceOps: Please add approvals as comments in the internal doc (link posted), and ping @finance-approvals when done. We will not promote to production until all 3 signoffs are present.
Jordan: Drafted vendor memo, posting to doc now -> please review.
Maya: OK — plan recap: 16:00 PT flip to sandbox A/B with 50 customers; shadow-invoice overnight; reconciliation report by Sophia tomorrow AM; vendor memo & 3 approvals by EOD; rollback triggers set.
Rohan: :thumbsup: I'll watch invoices and alerts.
Sophia: On it — will post diffs under the doc and tag leads.
Maya: If all green, we schedule the broader phased rollout next Tue. Otherwise, we'll hold and iterate.
FinanceOps: Noted. tagging @BillingTeam for visibility.
BillingBot: [system] job_78321 started at 2026-03-03T02:00:06Z
Maya: Thanks everyone — updating the kickoff checklist now.
Elena: One more ask — can we ensure customers in the sandbox cohort get an in-product banner about the pricing experiment? PM to coordinate.
Jordan: Will coordinate with PM and provide banner copy by EOD.
Maya: Perfect. Closing the loop here unless anyone has blockers.
